---
name: curation-entry
description: Add a high-value resource to Ventura Awesome with category purpose and canonical source verified. Use when extending the curated resource collection. Do not use when the resource is promotional noise duplicate material or copied upstream content.
---

# Curation entry

- Verify the resource exists and fits an existing category before creating a new one.
- Prefer resources with clear technical or educational value.
- Record the canonical link and concise reason for inclusion.
- Avoid duplicates aliases and low-signal promotional entries.
- Distinguish external reference from Ventura-owned content.
- Keep category ordering and formatting consistent.
